# Official upgrade v0.1.170

- Base: `vendor-0.1.169`
- Target: `v0.1.170`
- State: `validated-local-finalization-pending`
- Reason: Six merge conflicts and all identified Custom semantic overlaps are resolved; local finalization follows the candidate-tree gates.
- Custom base commit: `e1fcd8f84f2243f96786bbce31b21cf48891b3f9`
- Official target commit: `c043c24774228ba891ddf90d783aa6dc7d0855b5`
- Upgrade branch: `upgrade/v0.1.170`
- Planned Vendor Tag: `vendor-0.1.170` (annotated, exact official target)

## Official delta summary

- 38 non-merge official commits.
- 242 changed files: 14,821 insertions and 1,016 deletions.
- Primary changes include per-group profit admission control, multi-platform
  upstream billing probe synchronization, moderation proxy selection, SMTP
  fixes, scheduler/billing fixes, and additional protocol regression coverage.
- The repository and official target share the reviewed `vendor-0.1.169`
  ancestor, so this upgrade uses a normal two-parent merge.

## Merge and conflict resolution

Six textual conflicts required semantic resolution:

- `backend/ent/group.go` and `backend/ent/mutation.go` combine the Custom
  `minimum_balance` field with the three official profit-control fields.
- `backend/internal/service/api_key_auth_cache_impl.go` keeps snapshot version
  18 while adding the official profit fields. Old v18 snapshots decode the
  new fields to safe zero values, and enabling or changing profit control
  already invalidates the cache.
- `backend/internal/service/payment_config_service.go` adopts the official
  per-field explicit update branches and removes the superseded Custom write
  helper. Only the Custom channel-settings parse/serialize bridge remains.
- `backend/internal/service/payment_config_service_test.go` carries both the
  Custom regression coverage and the new official cases.
- `frontend/src/views/admin/GroupsView.vue` resets both the Custom minimum-
  balance state and official profit-control state when the editor closes.

No unresolved index entries or conflict markers remain.

Ent regeneration in an isolated target found one silent generated-code
mismerge: official runtime indices assumed no Custom `minimum_balance` field
and panicked at startup with a type assertion. The three profit-control field
indices in `backend/ent/runtime/runtime.go` were corrected to 50, 51, and 52;
the remaining 284 generated files match a fresh generator result, excluding
the repository's intentional Custom generator companions.

## Final official-path reconciliation

Of the 242 official changed paths, 197 are byte-identical to official
`v0.1.170`; 45 retain reviewed Custom differences. Custom bridge tests were
updated for the official `ProxyRepository` constructor parameter. The runtime
Custom moderation page now carries the official proxy selector, loads the
proxy catalog fail-soft, and sends the selected `proxy_id` on both save and
API-key test requests.

## Database gate

- The official delta adds `backend/migrations/192_group_profit_control.sql`:
  `groups.profit_control_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE`,
  `profit_min_margin DECIMAL(10,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, and
  `profit_safety_buffer DECIMAL(10,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`.
- `backend/migrations/193_group_profit_control_auth_cache_invalidation.sql`
  replaces `enqueue_group_auth_cache_invalidation()` so direct SQL and crash
  recovery also invalidate cached authorization snapshots after profit or
  pricing inputs change.
- The migration runner keys `schema_migrations` by full filename and sorts by
  full filename. Custom `192_add_group_minimum_balance.sql` therefore does not
  collide with official `192_group_profit_control.sql`; the safe order is the
  Custom 192, official 192, then official 193.
- The reviewed four-tree database fingerprint is
  `4330098491e05632f45fb976c0bb260c1c0bd3ca3b676d85c5eb94b802dc5515`.
- No production database was accessed and no DDL was executed locally.

Production read-only verification SQL:

```sql
SELECT filename, checksum, applied_at
FROM schema_migrations
WHERE filename IN (
  '192_add_group_minimum_balance.sql',
  '192_group_profit_control.sql',
  '193_group_profit_control_auth_cache_invalidation.sql'
)
ORDER BY filename;

SELECT column_name, data_type, numeric_precision, numeric_scale,
       column_default, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'public'
  AND table_name = 'groups'
  AND column_name IN (
    'minimum_balance',
    'profit_control_enabled',
    'profit_min_margin',
    'profit_safety_buffer'
  )
ORDER BY column_name;

SELECT pg_get_functiondef(
  'enqueue_group_auth_cache_invalidation()'::regprocedure
);
```

Application startup applies the repository migrations. Production rollout
must first back up `groups`, `schema_migrations`, and the existing trigger
function definition. A normal application rollback may leave the additive,
defaulted columns and compatible trigger in place; destructive column removal
is not an automatic rollback path and requires a separate approved database
restore or migration.

## Regression-risk review

- Official profit admission, group DTO visibility, scheduling rechecks,
  gateway pricing, and authentication-cache invalidation are covered by the
  new official tests plus existing Custom minimum-balance tests.
- Payment configuration uses the official per-field explicit update semantics
  while retaining only the Custom channel-settings parse/serialize bridge; it
  passes both Custom and official regressions.
- Moderation retains Custom overall/API-audit scope isolation while accepting
  the official proxy repository, backend request path, API type, and runtime
  Custom UI behavior.
- Official multi-platform billing probe, account bulk actions, SMTP,
  subscription, prompt audit, protocol compatibility, and frontend changes
  are covered by the full backend and frontend suites.
